Vacancy for Junior Clerk cum Typist
Friday, 18 November 2022
4795 Hits
Applications on plain paper enclosed with the certified photocopies of the educational qualification and experience are invited for the post of Junior Clerk which must reach to the Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Po. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha 442102 latest by
30
th
November 2022
.  Candidates must have to submit copy of registration with Employment Exchange.  Candidates belonging to Reserve Category should submit copy of Caste Certificate and Validity certificate.
Junior Clerk cum Typist
- 4 posts (1 SC, 1 EWS, 1 OBC, 1 Open)
Qualification
&
Experience
– Must have Graduation from Govt. recognized Institute approved by University, proficiency in operating computers, MSCIT and one year experience as Clerk in teaching Institute is required.  Candidate having experience in a Medical College will be preferred.
Salary:
As per KHS rules.
Age Limit
: Between 18 to 38 years for open category candidates / between 18 & 43 for reserved category candidates.
Note:
1. Suitable & experienced candidates can be considered for relaxation in age limit.
Decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
